video_title: Will Wemby's Fatigue COST Spurs a Title??

quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks fans made a strong presence at the Spurs arena

quotes.quote: This twist was that these Knicks fans absolutely showed out and they didn't take over the building, but they were there. I'm looking down and Jalen Brunson is hitting bucket after bucket, and a buddy of mine on press row pulls up a graphic that basically, the point of the whole graphic was historical data from fourth quarters in the playoffs, and it was like Michael Jordan is here, and Jalen Brunson was here, in the past 12 games. What he's doing is crazy.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's physical fatigue and playing style compared to Yao Ming
quotes.excerpt: it's a physiological thing where they hit a wall in ways that are different
quotes.quote: It's crazy because he's so light. It's one thing if you've seen these bigs, I covered Yao Ming, and Yao was incredible, but he would hit a wall, he would crash, but he was a massive human being. You see these guys who are that size, it's a physiological thing where they hit a wall in ways that are different. They hit a wall in ways that are different.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's dismissive comments about being worried after a loss
quotes.excerpt: to me you want to have confidence, so what do you expect him to say? I'm scared?
quotes.quote: To me you want to have confidence, so what do you expect him to say? I'm scared? His demeanor continues to fascinate me in terms of just how he chooses to use his voice because as we sat there and watched that press conference with him, there were four or five different little micro-moments where it felt like he was flexing to just kind of send that message that I'm not worried.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's quiet leadership and impact on the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: to see Kawhi Leonard quietly become the guy who in Minnesota it was like alright can they get it done
quotes.quote: Every player has a narrative attached to them. To see Kawhi Leonard quietly become the guy who in Minnesota it was like alright can they get it done with him, they go to the West Finals and this trade goes down and two Wolves make mostly an economic decision and move off of him. Those optics are tough for a guy who was that close to getting to the final stage.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs organization is unlikely to bench Dylan Harper

quotes.quote: It's very close to the best organization, so they're not going to even quietly share any of that stuff. My sense there though would be, and I could be wrong, if they get smoked in Game 2, then who knows if they got to do something. Game 1, it's not like Dylan Harper showed out in the kind of way that should push De'Aaron Fox out.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's potential as an All-Star and contract constraints
quotes.excerpt: Dylan has All-Star talent, but De'Aaron's contract ends up topping out at like 60 million dollars
quotes.quote: Dylan has All-Star talent, but De'Aaron's contract ends up topping out at like 60 million dollars. And so even if you at some point were able to talk to De'Aaron about, hey, what do you think about coming off the bench, just in terms of good basketball business, nobody's having a six-man make 60 million dollars. You can't work that way.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick

quotes.quote: Social media is tough, it's not reality, but it is reality. quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder's massive asset pool and potential for a big trade
quotes.excerpt: they got 12 first-round picks between now and 2032 and 13 second-round picks
quotes.quote: They got 12 first-round picks between now and 2032 and 13 second-round picks. You have everything. That money is going to burn a hole in your pocket, whether it's Giannis Antetokounmpo, whether it's somebody else. If I had to handicap it for now, I don't anticipate them going after Giannis, partly because the timeline, you are absolutely accelerating things if you add a 31-year-old with a lot of tough health history like Giannis has had.
